basic_info.description: Welcome to this stunning 3-level Glen Park home, where classic charm meets modern functionality. With 4 Bedrooms, 3 Bathrooms, Sunroom, Family Room, Deck, Backyard and 1-Car Parking, this 2,702sf residence offers both comfort and flexibility for families and professionals. Step inside to a light-filled Living Room with large windows, flowing into a formal Dining area and a gourmet Kitchen featuring a 48 4-burner Wolf range, griddle, grill and hood, along with custom cabinetry and a spacious island perfect for entertaining. At the rear, two serene Bedrooms and a bright Sunroom open to a private Deck and Backyard, creating a peaceful retreat. A beautifully tiled bathroom with a shower-over-tub completes this level. The upper level is dedicated to the luxurious Primary Suite, featuring breathtaking City views, a spacious walk-in closet, and an elegant ensuite Bathroom with a double vanity and dual-showerhead shower. The lower level offers a versatile Family Room, an additional Bedroom, full Bath, Laundry area, interior Garage access, and a separate entrance ideal for guests, a home office, or rental income. Located steps from Glen Canyon Park, shops, cafes, markets and public transit, this home also includes interior access to Garage, making it a rare find in a prime location
